description: This file defines API endpoints related to emoji reactions for a sports live stream platform. It includes route handlers for listing emojis, submitting emoji reactions, and retrieving reaction summaries. Uses FastAPI and interacts with repositories and websockets for real-time updates.

methods.name: list_emojis( pageNo: int = Query(1, ge=1, description="Page number"), pageSize: int = Query(10, ge=1, le=100, description="Page size"), request: Request = None, )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a paginated list of available emojis for reactions.

methods.name: create_emoji_reaction( reaction_request: EmojiReactionRequest = Body(...), request: Request = None, )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to submit a user's emoji reaction for a live event, updating reaction counts and broadcasting updates.

methods.name: get_event_reactions( event_id: str, request: Request = None, )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch the emoji reaction summary for a specific event.
